name: branding-logo-sheet-of-eleven-white-marks-on-charcoal
title: Grid of eleven diverse white logos on charcoal: badges, wordmarks, mascot and crest
whatItIs: A charcoal slide with a tidy 4x3 arrangement of white logos of very different styles: an oval monogram, a character mascot in red, a cut-paper wordmark, a logistics symbol, condensed wordmarks, a script signature, a badge, a diamond emblem and a shield crest.
whatItMeans: Shows range at a glance; dark uniform background lets every style read equally.
techniques: Reverse all logos to white on a single dark field.
Keep sizes and spacing consistent for comparison.
Introduce one colour accent (the red mascot) as a focal point.
Add tiny title and credit labels.

vocabulary.definition: A grid showing many logos together.
A logo shown light on dark.
A logo enclosed in an emblem shape.
One coloured item among monochrome ones.
